## New/Unique Files in beellama Fork

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| **`server-adaptive-dm.h`** | Adaptive speculative decoding depth management. Implements two controllers — "fringe" and "profit" — that dynamically adjust draft token counts based on EWMA-smoothed acceptance rates. Includes helper functions for building candidate depth lists, computing required fringe thresholds, and deciding when to preserve state for continuation. No upstream equivalent. |
| **`server-chat.cpp` / `server-chat.h`** | Format converter for the OpenAI Responses API. Translates `responses_create` input format (with `input`, `instructions`, and structured content arrays) into the internal chat completion message format. Handles input_text, input_image, input_audio, output_message, and function_call item types. This is a compatibility shim, not present in upstream. |
| **`server-cors-proxy.h`** | HTTP proxy handler that forwards arbitrary requests to external URLs. Parses target URLs, strips `x-proxy-header-*` prefixes to reconstruct forwarded headers, and uses `server_http_proxy` with configurable read/write timeouts. Enables the server to act as a reverse proxy — no upstream equivalent. |
| **`server-loop-guard.cpp` / `server-loop-guard.h`** | Reasoning loop detection system. Maintains sliding-window tails of reasoning and visible tokens, then checks for (a) periodic repetition patterns and (b) n-gram dominance to detect when a model is stuck in a reasoning/thinking loop. Can trigger early termination. This is a beellama-specific safety feature for reasoning models. |
| **`server-tools.cpp` / `server-tools.h`** | External tool execution engine. Defines a `server_tool` abstract base class with `get_definition()` and `invoke()` methods, plus a `server_tools` registry. Uses `sheredom/subprocess.h` to spawn external processes with timeout handling, output capture, and truncation. Enables the server to run real external tools (not just function-calling simulation). |
